description: Complete 8-row import with one guardian, phone and pickup schedule per child; prepared write-name matching saves five statements. Measured by TestStudentImportPhoneGrowthQueryBudget. Newly inserted guardian profiles are passed to the link command in the same transaction instead of being read again. Newly created children also carry the enrollment command result to the link, avoiding the repeated child read while its insert remains protected by the same transaction. The first phone of a newly created guardian uses the same-transaction create fact instead of re-reading the empty phone list, count and maximum priority; later phones and reused guardians retain the read. Each phone add reads the complete guardian profile under its existing row lock in one statement instead of locking and reading separately. Non-primary guardian links clear retention and insert the relationship in one dependent statement, preserving the guardian row lock and unconditional retention write. The batch path writes each row without a row savepoint, because a failed row aborts its whole chunk (#5552, ADR 0067 addendum step 3). The chunk executor creates the persons of a create chunk of six or more rows in one statement and reads the segment's names once in ResolveChunk (#5552, ADR 0067 addendum step 5). Step 5b writes the retention consents and the consent history of the segment's rows each in one statement under a second bound; schedules stay per row (#5552, PR #6408). Step 7 creates the student profiles of a segment in one statement before the rows and their care profiles in one statement after them; memberships stay per row (#5552, PR #6558).
